title: AVAX Is EXPLODING: Developer Growth Just Went Parabolic! - AVAX Price Prediction
description:
AVAX Is EXPLODING: Developer Growth Just Went Parabolic! - AVAX AVALANCHE  - AVAX Technical Analysis-AVAX Price Prediction 2025-Technical analysis tutorial: 

In this video, we break down Avalanche’s latest developer-activity update, and the numbers are extremely strong.
Builder Hub accounts are up 20×, unique contract deployers have passed 400K, verified contracts are now over 700K, and the ecosystem is tracking more than 550 active projects.

These metrics give us a clear look at how fast the Avalanche ecosystem is expanding from the builder side, which is one of the strongest long-term signals for any blockchain.
After covering the key data points, we look at the AVAX chart to see how the market is reacting.

If you’re following AVAX or the broader Proof-of-Stake space, this update is worth paying attention to.
